label: dragIsOneStep: the drag token isn't passed to setTransform, so a 60-sample drag is 60 undo steps (.dragIsOneStep)
find: try target.setTransform(t, name: name, drag: drag)
replace: try target.setTransform(t, name: name, drag: nil)

label: flipHonoursHelp: flip's availability skips the target's flipHelp, so a layer that can't mirror flips anyway (.flipHonoursHelp)
rotateIsRelative: transform.rotate sets the turn to its degrees instead of adding them (.rotateIsRelative)
